purpose: This vaccine helps protect you against a serious bacterial infection called meningococcal disease, specifically caused by group B bacteria. This infection can lead to meningitis, which is a dangerous swelling of the lining around the brain and spinal cord, and can also cause a severe bloodstream infection. Getting vaccinated is one of the best ways to reduce your risk of getting this potentially life-threatening illness.
how_it_works: This vaccine contains four different protein pieces from the meningococcal B bacteria — not the live bacteria itself, so it cannot give you the infection. When it is injected, your immune system recognizes these proteins as foreign and builds up antibodies to fight them. That way, if you are ever exposed to the real bacteria in the future, your immune system is already prepared to fight it off quickly.
common_side_effects: Most people feel some soreness, redness, or swelling at the injection site — this is very common and normal. You might also feel tired, have a headache, muscle aches, chills, or a mild fever for a day or two after the shot. These side effects are a sign that your body is building protection and usually go away on their own within a few days.
warnings: Tell your doctor or pharmacist if you have ever had a severe allergic reaction to a previous dose of this vaccine or any of its ingredients. If you develop signs of a serious allergic reaction after the shot — such as difficulty breathing, swelling of the face or throat, a fast heartbeat, or dizziness — seek emergency help right away. This vaccine should generally be postponed if you are currently very sick with a moderate or severe illness. Fainting can sometimes happen after any vaccine, so you will usually be asked to sit or lie down for about 15 minutes after receiving it.
typical_dosing: For most teens and adults, this vaccine is given as two separate shots, with each dose at least one month apart. Your doctor will decide the exact schedule based on your age and health situation. Both doses are needed to get the full protection, so it is important to complete the series.
